invariants.description: phi_P_CO2_a is the normalised CO2 reactivity sigmoid (0 at P_CO2_a_nom)
x_CO2 = phi (1 - exp(-t/tau_CO2)); G_p = 1 - g_O2_b x_O2 + x_CO2; R = 1/G_p
the cerebral conductance factor stays positive

bc_sweep.rationale: PaCO2 25-70 mmHg (the range of CO2-reactivity data); C_O2_p 0.08-0.19 ml/ml (cerebral venous/capillary O2 content from hypoxic to hyperoxic); G_p becomes <= 0 (negative resistance) above ~C_O2_vb_nom + (1 + x_CO2)/g_O2_b, so g_O2_b is limited to 0.5-1.5x.

baseline.reason: Candidate: steady-state CBF vs PaCO2 (the reactivity curve the A-D sigmoid was fitted to, e.g. Harper & Glass 1965 / Reivich 1964 as used by Ursino & Lodi); R_mult = 1/G_p predicts relative CBF at constant pressure, so a digitised CBF(PaCO2) table would be a direct baseline. Not set up (data not obtained).
